description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - Merchant Shipping (Radio Communications) Regulations No. 05 of 2021
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Merchant Shipping Act, establishing new legal requirements for radio communications on ships. It creates a regulatory framework for maritime safety communications, specifies applicability rules, and outlines functional requirements for radio equipment. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it establishes new statutory instruments and compliance requirements.
